metadata.source: Bombay 1912, adapted as "āgneya-viṣṇudharmottarapurāṇādibhya āhṛtya pratisaṃskritam [dūrgāmohanabhaṭṭācāryeṇa]" in D. Bhattacharyya, "Lights on the Paippalāda Recension of the Atharvaveda". In: Our Heritage, Vol. III, part I, 1955. pp. 1-14.

children.text: puṣkara uvāca-
children.translated_text: <s>Puṣkara</s> said:

children.text: śāntātītaṃ gaṇaṃ hutvā śāntim āpnoti mānavaḥ /
children.translated_text: Having offered the <s>Śānta</s> group of mantras into the fire, a person attains peace;

children.text: bhaiṣajyaṃ ca gaṇaṃ hutvā sarvān rogān vyapohati // Vdho_2,127.1 //
children.translated_text: and having offered the <s>Bhaiṣajya</s> (medicinal) group, one dispels all diseases. (Vdho 2.127.1)

children.text: triṣaptīyaṃ gaṇaṃ hutvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate /
children.translated_text: Having offered the <s>Triṣaptī</s> group, one is freed from all sins;

children.text: kvacin nāapnoti ca bhayaṃ hutvā caivābhayaṃ gaṇam // Vdho_2,127.2 //
children.translated_text: and one never encounters fear, having offered the <s>Abhaya</s> (fearlessness) group into the fire. (Vdho 2.127.2)

children.text: na parājāyate rāma gaṇaṃ hutvāparājitam /
children.translated_text: One is not defeated, O <s>Rāma</s>, having offered the <s>Aparājita</s> (unconquered) group;

children.text: āyuṣyaṃ ca gaṇam hutvā cāpamṛtyūṃ vyapohati // Vdho_2,127.3 //
children.translated_text: and having offered the <s>Āyuṣya</s> (life-giving) group, one dispels untimely death. (Vdho 2.127.3)

children.text: svastim āpnoti sarvatra hutvā svastyayanaṃ gaṇaṃ /
children.translated_text: One attains well-being everywhere, having offered the <s>Svastyayana</s> (benedictory) group;

children.text: śreyasā yogam āpnoti śarmavarmagaṇaṃ tathā // Vdho_2,127.4 //
children.translated_text: and one attains connection with prosperity, likewise through the <s>Śarmavarma</s> (protection-armor) group. (Vdho 2.127.4)

children.text: vāstoṣpatyagaṇaṃ hutvā vāstudoṣān vyapohati /
children.translated_text: Having offered the <s>Vāstoṣpatya</s> group, one dispels defects of the dwelling;

children.text: tathā raudragaṇaṃ hutvā sarvān doṣān vyapohati //
children.translated_text: and having offered the <s>Raudra</s> group, one dispels all defects.

body.text: etair daśagaṇair homo hy aṣṭādaśasu śāntiṣu // Vdho_2,127.5 //
body.translated_text: With these ten groups, the <s>homa</s> (fire oblation) is performed in the eighteen <s>śāntis</s> (pacification rites). (Vdho 2.127.5)

children.text: vaiṣṇavī śāntir aindrī ca brāhmī raudrī tathaiva ca /
children.translated_text: The <s>Vaiṣṇavī</s> pacification rite, the <s>Aindrī</s>, the <s>Brāhmī</s>, the <s>Raudrī</s> likewise,

children.text: vāyavyā vāruṇī caiva kauberī bhārgavī tathā // Vdho_2,127.6 //
children.translated_text: the <s>Vāyavyā</s>, the <s>Vāruṇī</s>, the <s>Kauberī</s>, the <s>Bhārgavī</s> likewise, (Vdho 2.127.6)

children.text: prājāpatyā tathā tvāṣṭrī kaumārī vahnidevatā /
children.translated_text: the <s>Prājāpatyā</s>, then the <s>Tvāṣṭrī</s>, the <s>Kaumārī</s>, the one with <s>Agni</s> as deity,

children.text: mārudgaṇā ca gāndharvī śāntair nairṛtakī tathā // Vdho_2,127.7 //
children.translated_text: the <s>Mārudgaṇā</s>, the <s>Gāndharvī</s>, the <s>Nairṛtakī</s> likewise with pacification rites, (Vdho 2.127.7)

body.text: śāntir āṅgirasī yāmyā pārthivī ca bhṛgūttama /
body.translated_text: the <s>Āṅgirasī</s> pacification rite, the <s>Yāmyā</s>, and the <s>Pārthivī</s>, O best of <s>Bhṛgus</s>;

body.text: etās tu śāntayaḥ proktāḥ sarvakarmahitāḥ sadā // Vdho_2,127.8 //
body.translated_text: these pacification rites are declared, always beneficial for all ritual actions. (Vdho 2.127.8)

body.text: yas tvā mṛtyur iti hy etaj japtaṃ mṛtyuvināśanaṃ /
body.translated_text: The hymn "<s>yas tvā mṛtyuḥ</s>" — reciting this destroys death;

body.text: hutvā ca mātṛnāmāni kāmān evam avāpnuyāt // Vdho_2,127.9 //
body.translated_text: and having offered with the names of the Mothers, one thus obtains one's desires. (Vdho 2.127.9)

children.text: suparṇas tveti hutvā ca bhujagair naiva bādhyate /
children.translated_text: Having offered with the hymn "<s>suparṇas tu</s>," one is not afflicted by serpents;

children.text: Bhattacharyya edits bhujagainava bādhyate, which can be just a typo!
children.translated_text: <s>Bhattacharyya</s> edits "bhujagainava bādhyate," which may be simply a typographical error.

children.text: yasyedaṃ bhūmyām iti ca bhūmikāmo japet sadā // Vdho_2,127.10 //
children.translated_text: and one who desires land should always recite "<s>yasyedaṃ bhūmyām</s>." (Vdho 2.127.10)

children.text: pṛthivyām uttamo 'sīti hutaṃ śraiṣṭhyapradaṃ sadā /
children.translated_text: The hymn "<s>pṛthivyām uttamo 'si</s>" when offered always bestows preeminence;

children.text: audumbaraṃ yo na iti tathā vīryavivardhanam // Vdho_2,127.11 //
children.translated_text: and "<s>audumbaraṃ yo na</s>" likewise increases virility. (Vdho 2.127.11)

children.text: indreṇa dattam ity etat sarvabādhāvināśanam /
children.translated_text: "<s>Indreṇa dattam</s>" — this destroys all afflictions;

children.text: hiraṇyavarṇā iti ca snānaṃ pāpaharaṃ bhavet // Vdho_2,127.12 //
children.translated_text: and bathing with "<s>hiraṇyavarṇāḥ</s>" removes sin. (Vdho 2.127.12)

children.text: asitasyeti sarvāṇi viṣaghnāni bhṛgūttama /
children.translated_text: "<s>Asitasya</s>" — all of these destroy poison, O best of <s>Bhṛgus</s>;

children.text: sarasvatīti mantrāṃś ca viṣaghnān nirviśed budhaḥ // Vdho_2,127.13 //
children.translated_text: and the wise one should neutralize poison with the mantras of "<s>Sarasvatī</s>" that destroy poison. (Vdho 2.127.13)

body.translated_text: "<s>Śarabha</s>" and all the others are destroyers of <s>piśācas</s> (malevolent spirits);

body.text: imā devīti mantraś ca sarvaśāntikaraḥ paraḥ // Vdho_2,127.14 //
body.translated_text: and the mantra "<s>imā devīḥ</s>" is the supreme bestower of all pacification. (Vdho 2.127.14)

children.text: devā maruta ity etat sarvakāmakaraṃ bhavet /
children.translated_text: "<s>Devā marutaḥ</s>" — this fulfills all desires;

children.text: yamasya lokād ity etad duḥsvapnaśamanaṃ paraṃ // Vdho_2,127.15 //
children.translated_text: "<s>Yamasya lokāt</s>" — this is the supreme remedy for bad dreams. (Vdho 2.127.15)

children.text: agner va iti cāpy etat kathitaṃ manyunāśanam /
children.translated_text: "<s>Agner vaḥ</s>" — this too is said to destroy anger;

children.text: ūrdhvo bhavati vijñeyaḥ kṛtvā sthānakaraḥ paraḥ // Vdho_2,127.16 //
children.translated_text: "<s>Ūrdhvaḥ bhavati</s>" should be known as the supreme bestower of a position. (Vdho 2.127.16)

children.text: indraṃ vayaṃ vaṇijam iti paṇyalābhakaraṃ param /
children.translated_text: "<s>Indraṃ vayaṃ vaṇijam</s>" — this is the supreme bestower of profit in trade;

children.text: Bhattacharyya: baṇijaṃ
children.translated_text: <s>Bhattacharyya</s>: "baṇijaṃ"

children.text: kāmo me rājña ity etat strīṇāṃ saubhāgyavardhanam // Vdho_2,127.17 //
children.translated_text: "<s>Kāmo me rājñaḥ</s>" — this increases the good fortune of women. (Vdho 2.127.17)

children.text: bhadrāya karṇam ity etat karṇaprasyandane japet /
children.translated_text: "<s>Bhadrāya karṇam</s>" — this should be recited for ear discharge;

children.text: bhadrāsy akṣirodhe jātā karṇaprasyandane tathā // Vdho_2,127.18 //
children.translated_text: "<s>Bhadrāsy akṣirodhe jātā</s>" likewise for ear discharge. (Vdho 2.127.18)

children.text: tubyam eva jarimann āyuṣyaṃ tu hutaṃ bhavet /
children.translated_text: "<s>Tubhyam eva jarimān</s>" — when offered, it bestows long life;

children.text: āyātu mitra ity etan mitralabdhikaraṃ hutam // Vdho_2,127.19 //
children.translated_text: "<s>Āyātu mitraḥ</s>" — this when offered brings the acquisition of friends. (Vdho 2.127.19)

children.text: āśāsānam idaṃ janā miśradhānyena homayet /
children.translated_text: "<s>Āśāsānam idaṃ janāḥ</s>" — one should offer with mixed grains;

children.text: ādhipatyam avāpnoti sarvatra manujottama // Vdho_2,127.20 //
children.translated_text: one attains sovereignty everywhere, O best of men. (Vdho 2.127.20)

children.text: agne gobhir na ity etad gavāṃ vṛddhikaraṃ param /
children.translated_text: "<s>Agne gobhir naḥ</s>" — this is the supreme means of increasing cattle;

children.text: dvādaśāhaṃ tu juhuyāt parākeṇa viśeṣataḥ // Vdho_2,127.21 //
children.translated_text: one should offer for twelve days, especially with a <s>parāka</s> (special fast). (Vdho 2.127.21)

children.text: śānto agnir itīty etad grāmasvāsthyakaraṃ bhavet /
children.translated_text: "<s>Śānto agniḥ</s>" — this brings well-being to the village;

children.text: tasmād grāmān mṛdā kṛtvā vedisāmyaṃ samaśnute // Vdho_2,127.22 //
children.translated_text: therefore, having made bricks from earth of the village, one attains equality with the altar. (Vdho 2.127.22)

children.text: vidmāsya sarvā cittāni rāṣṭrasvīkaraṇāni tu /
children.translated_text: "<s>Vidmā asya sarvā cittāni</s>" — for winning over a kingdom;

children.text: tribhyo rudrebhya ity etad vāstoṣpatam udāhṛtam // Vdho_2,127.23 //
children.translated_text: "<s>Tribhyo Rudrebhyaḥ</s>" — this is declared as the <s>Vāstoṣpata</s> (Lord of the dwelling) rite. (Vdho 2.127.23)

children.text: dhruvaṃ dhruveṇeti hutaṃ sthānalābhakaraṃ bhavet /
children.translated_text: "<s>Dhruvaṃ dhruveṇa</s>" when offered brings the attainment of a position;

children.text: acyutā dyaus tathā rāma kathitaṃ sthānalābhadam // Vdho_2,127.24 //
children.translated_text: "<s>Acyutā dyauḥ</s>" likewise, O <s>Rāma</s>, is said to bestow the attainment of a position. (Vdho 2.127.24)

children.text: payo deveṣv iti hutaṃ rāyaspoṣakaraṃ param /
children.translated_text: "<s>Payaḥ deveṣu</s>" when offered is the supreme means of increasing prosperity;

children.text: yunakrasīreti śunā kṛṣilābhakaraṃ bhavet // Vdho_2,127.25 //
children.translated_text: "<s>Yunakra sīra</s>" — this when offered with a ploughshare brings the acquisition of agricultural wealth. (Vdho 2.127.25)

children.text: ayaṃ te yonir ity etat putralābhakaraṃ bhavet /
children.translated_text: "<s>Ayaṃ te yoniḥ</s>" — this brings the acquisition of a son;

children.text: śunaṃ vatsān tathā hy etad gavāṃ vṛddhikaraṃ hutam // Vdho_2,127.26 //
children.translated_text: [The mantra beginning with] 'the dog, the calves' — this oblation is indeed conducive to the increase of cattle. || Vdho 2.127.26 ||

body.translated_text: [The mantra beginning with] '...' is said to bring about supreme excellence in all things;

body.text: ahaṃ te bhaga ity etad bhavet saubhāgyavardhanaṃ // Vdho_2,127.27 //
body.translated_text: [the mantra] 'I am your fortune' (<s>ahaṃ te bhaga</s>) — this brings about increase of good fortune. || Vdho 2.127.27 ||

children.text: ye te pāśās tathāpy etad bandhanān mokṣakārakam /
children.translated_text: [The mantra] 'those bonds of yours' (<s>ye te pāśāḥ</s>) — this likewise brings about liberation from bondage;

children.text: yo na sva iti cāpy etac chatrunāśakaraṃ param // Vdho_2,127.28 //
children.translated_text: and [the mantra] 'who is not one's own' (<s>yo na svaḥ</s>) — this is supreme in destroying enemies. || Vdho 2.127.28 ||

children.text: sapatnahanam iti tathā nātra kāryā vicāraṇā /
children.translated_text: [The mantra] 'destroyer of rivals' (<s>sapatnahanam</s>) — in this there should be no doubt;

children.text: tvam uttamam itīty etad yaśaso vardhanaṃ param // Vdho_2,127.29 //
children.translated_text: [the mantra] 'you are the supreme' (<s>tvam uttamam</s>) — this is supreme in increasing fame. || Vdho 2.127.29 ||

children.text: yathā mṛgo gopayasi strīṇāṃ saubhāgyavardhanam /
children.translated_text: [The mantra] 'as a deer you guard' (<s>yathā mṛgo gopayasi</s>) — increases the good fortune of women;

children.text: ā no agna ity etac ca kathitaṃ patilābhadam // Vdho_2,127.30 //
children.translated_text: and [the mantra] 'come to us, O <s>Agni</s>' (<s>ā no agna</s>) — this is said to bestow the attainment of a husband. || Vdho 2.127.30 ||

children.text: yena vehad iṣaṃ caiva garbhalābhakaraṃ bhavet /
children.translated_text: [The mantra] 'by which' (<s>yena</s>) and 'the great arrow' (<s>vehad iṣam</s>) — these bring about the attainment of progeny;

children.text: imaṃ tapasvinn iti tathā bhavet saubhāgyavardhanam // Vdho_2,127.31 //
children.translated_text: [the mantra] 'this one, O ascetic' (<s>imaṃ tapasvinn</s>) — likewise brings about increase of good fortune. || Vdho 2.127.31 ||

children.text: yat pṛthivyā anāvṛttaṃ hutam etad yathāvidhi /
children.translated_text: [The mantra] 'that which on the earth is uncovered' (<s>yat pṛthivyā anāvṛtam</s>) — when this oblation is offered according to the prescribed rites,

children.text: Bhattacharyya typo: pṛvivyā
children.translated_text: Note: Bhattacharyya has a typo: <s>pṛvivyā</s>

children.text: kṛtvā tu śaṃsanaṃ jñeyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā // Vdho_2,127.32 //
children.translated_text: having performed the laudatory recitation (<s>śaṃsana</s>), the result should be known; in this there should be no doubt. || Vdho 2.127.32 ||

children.text: śivaḥ śivābhir ity etad bhavec chreyas^karaṃ param // Vdho_2,127.33 //
children.translated_text: [The mantra] '<s>Śiva</s> with the auspicious ones' (<s>śivaḥ śivābhiḥ</s>) — this brings about supreme welfare. || Vdho 2.127.33 ||

children.text: kṛtyādūṣaṇa ity etat kṛtyādūṣaṇam ucyate /
children.translated_text: [The mantra] 'counteracting of sorcery' (<s>kṛtyādūṣaṇa</s>) — this is called the counteracting of sorcery (<s>kṛtyā</s>);

children.text: bṛhaspatiḥ paripātu pathi svastyayanaṃ bhavet // Vdho_2,127.34 //
children.translated_text: [the mantra] 'may <s>Bṛhaspati</s> protect' — this brings about safety on a journey (<s>svastyayana</s>). || Vdho 2.127.34 ||

children.text: mano nv edam abhayadaṃ pathi svastyayanaṃ bhavet /
children.translated_text: [The mantra] 'this mind of ours' (<s>mano nv edam</s>) — this bestows fearlessness and brings about safety on a journey;

children.text: ayaṃ no agnir adhyakṣo bhaved agniprasādataḥ // Vdho_2,127.35 //
children.translated_text: [the mantra] 'this <s>Agni</s> of ours is the presiding one' (<s>ayaṃ no agnir adhyakṣaḥ</s>) — this brings about the grace of <s>Agni</s>. || Vdho 2.127.35 ||

body.text: saṃvatsaraṃ tu śirasā dhārayed yo hutāśanam //
body.translated_text: One who bears the fire (<s>hutāśana</s>) on one's head for a year,

body.text: mantram etaj japen nityam āgneyāśāmukhaḥ sthitaḥ //
body.translated_text: should recite this <s>mantra</s> daily, standing facing the direction of <s>Agni</s> (southeast);

body.text: anagnijvalanaṃ kuryād rāma saṃvatsare gate // Vdho_2,127.36 //
body.translated_text: after the year has passed, O <s>Rāma</s>, one should perform the rite of the non-kindling of fire (<s>anagnijvalana</s>). || Vdho 2.127.36 ||

children.text: dūṣyā dūṣītty etaj japen mantram anuttamam /
children.translated_text: [The mantra] 'O corrupting one, [you are] corrupted' (<s>dūṣyā dūṣī</s>) — one should recite this supreme <s>mantra</s>;

children.text: kuryāt pratisarābandhaṃ sarvadoṣanibarhaṇam // Vdho_2,127.37 //
children.translated_text: one should perform the binding of a protective amulet (<s>pratisarābandha</s>), which removes all faults. || Vdho 2.127.37 ||

children.text: prāṇasūktañ ca kathitaṃ tathā prāṇavivardhanam /
children.translated_text: The <s>Prāṇasūkta</s> (hymn of the vital breath) is said to be the increaser of <s>prāṇa</s> (life-force);

children.text: muñcāmi tveti kathitam apamṛtyuvimokṣaṇam // Vdho_2,127.38 //
children.translated_text: [the mantra] 'I release you' (<s>muñcāmi tvā</s>) is said to be the deliverer from untimely death (<s>apamṛtyu</s>). || Vdho 2.127.38 ||

children.text: atharvaśiraso 'dhyetā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate /
children.translated_text: One who studies the <s>Atharvaśiras</s> (Head of the Atharvaveda) is freed from all sins;

children.text: paramaṃ pāvanaṃ tad dhi sarvakalmaṣanāśanam // Vdho_2,127.39 //
children.translated_text: for it is supremely purifying and destroys all defilement. || Vdho 2.127.39 ||

children.text: evam ete śubhā mantrāḥ prativedaṃ mayā tava /
children.translated_text: Thus these auspicious <s>mantras</s>, from each <s>Veda</s>, have been told to you by me,

children.text: samāsāt kathitā rāma samuddhṛtya pradhānataḥ // Vdho_2,127.40 //
children.translated_text: in summary, O <s>Rāma</s>, having extracted them principally. || Vdho 2.127.40 ||

children.text: ekaikasya ca mantrasya viniyogāḥ sahasraśaḥ /
children.translated_text: The applications (<s>viniyoga</s>) of each single <s>mantra</s> are thousands [in number];

children.text: Bhattacharyya: viniyogaḥ
children.translated_text: Note: Bhattacharyya reads <s>viniyogaḥ</s> (singular)

children.text: kathitā bhṛguśārdūla purāṇaiḥ sumahātmabhiḥ // Vdho_2,127.41 //
children.translated_text: they have been described, O tiger among the <s>Bhṛgus</s>, by the <s>Purāṇas</s> [composed] by great souls. || Vdho 2.127.41 ||

children.text: na te śakyā mahābhāga vaktuṃ varṣaśatair api /
children.translated_text: They cannot be told, O greatly fortunate one, even in a hundred years;

children.text: prādhānyena tu mantrāṇāṃ kiñcit karma taveritam // Vdho_2,127.42 //
children.translated_text: but the principal function (<s>karma</s>) of the <s>mantras</s> has been declared to you. || Vdho 2.127.42 ||

children.text: home yatra na nirdiṣṭaṃ mayā dravyaṃ purā tava /
children.translated_text: In the oblation (<s>homa</s>) where no offering material (<s>dravya</s>) has been specified by me to you previously,

children.text: havīṃṣi tatra vakṣyāmi tāni me gadataḥ śṛṇu // Vdho_2,127.43 //
children.translated_text: I shall now declare the oblation materials (<s>havīṃṣi</s>); hear them as I speak. || Vdho 2.127.43 ||

children.text: vṛkṣāṇāṃ yajñiyānān tu samidhaḥ prathamaṃ haviḥ /
children.translated_text: The first oblation material is the sacrificial firewood (<s>samidh</s>) of trees suitable for sacrifice (<s>yajñīya</s>);

children.text: ājyañ ca vrīhayaś caiva tathā vai gaurasarṣapāḥ // Vdho_2,127.44 //
children.translated_text: and clarified butter (<s>ājya</s>), rice (<s>vrīhi</s>), and likewise white mustard seeds (<s>gaurasarṣapa</s>). || Vdho 2.127.44 ||

body.text: akṣatāni tilāś caiva dadhi kṣīrañ ca bhārgava /
body.translated_text: Unbroken grains (<s>akṣata</s>), sesame (<s>tila</s>), curd (<s>dadhi</s>), and milk (<s>kṣīra</s>), O <s>Bhārgava</s>;

body.text: darbhās tathaiva dūrvāś ca bilvāni kamalāni ca // Vdho_2,127.45 //
body.translated_text: <s>darbha</s> grass, likewise <s>dūrvā</s> grass, <s>bilva</s> (wood-apple) [leaves], and lotuses (<s>kamala</s>). || Vdho 2.127.45 ||

children.text: śāntipuṣṭikarāṇy āhur dravyāṇy etāni bhārgava /
children.translated_text: These materials are said to bring about peace (<s>śānti</s>) and prosperity (<s>puṣṭi</s>), O <s>Bhārgava</s>;

children.text: tailendhanāni dharmajña rājikāṃ rudhiraṃ viṣam /
children.translated_text: oil-based fuel, O knower of <s>dharma</s>, mustard (<s>rājikā</s>), blood (<s>rudhira</s>), poison (<s>viṣa</s>),

children.text: samidhaḥ kaṇṭakopetā abhicāreṣu yojayet // Vdho_2,127.46 //
children.translated_text: and firewood with thorns — these should be employed in hostile rites (<s>abhicāra</s>). || Vdho 2.127.46 ||

children.text: ārṣaṃ vai daivataṃ chandas tv avijñāya bhṛgūttama /
children.translated_text: Without knowing the seer (<s>ṛṣi</s>), the deity (<s>devatā</s>), and the meter (<s>chandas</s>), O best of <s>Bhṛgus</s>,

children.text: mantrasya tena mantreṇa japyahomau na kārayet // Vdho_2,127.47 //
children.translated_text: one should not cause the recitation (<s>japya</s>) or oblation (<s>homa</s>) to be performed with that <s>mantra</s>. || Vdho 2.127.47 ||

children.text: chandasi brāhmaṇe sūkte yad avyaktaṃ pradṛśyate /
children.translated_text: Whatever is unclear in the meter (<s>chandas</s>), in the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> [portion], or in the hymn (<s>sūkta</s>),

children.text: vidvadbhiḥ saha niścitya tad yajñam avatārayet // Vdho_2,127.48 //
children.translated_text: having determined it in consultation with the learned, one should then bring it into the sacrifice. || Vdho 2.127.48 ||

children.text: sambhārā ye yathā yatra yāni dravyāṇi yo vidhiḥ /
children.translated_text: Whatever materials are required, wherever and in whatever manner, whatever substances and whatever procedure —

children.text: śākhāṃ prati tathā tatra tat pramāṇam iti sthitiḥ // Vdho_2,127.49 //
children.translated_text: according to one's own [Vedic] branch (<s>śākhā</s>), that is the authority in that case — such is the established rule. || Vdho 2.127.49 ||

children.text: yaḥ svasūtram atikramya parasūtreṇa vartate /
children.translated_text: One who transgresses one's own <s>sūtra</s> (rule-text) and follows another's <s>sūtra</s>,

children.text: apramāṇam ṛṣiṃ kṛtvā so 'py adharmeṇa yujyate // Vdho_2,127.50 //
children.translated_text: having made the <s>ṛṣi</s> (sage) unauthoritative — that person too is tainted with <s>adharma</s> (unrighteousness). || Vdho 2.127.50 ||

children.text: tasmāt sarvaprayatnena svasūtraṃ na vilaṅghayet /
children.translated_text: Therefore, with every effort, one should not transgress one's own <s>sūtra</s>;

children.text: prāktantrottaratantre dve svaśākhāpratyaye dvija /
children.translated_text: the <s>prāktantra</s> (primary manual) and <s>uttaratantra</s> (supplementary manual) — these two are authoritative according to one's own [Vedic] branch (<s>śākhā</s>), O twice-born one (<s>dvija</s>).

children.text: sarvakarmasu kartavye madhye karma vidhīyate // Vdho_2,127.51 //
children.translated_text: Among all rites that should be performed, the [principal] rite is prescribed in the middle. // <s>Vdho</s> 2,127.51 //

children.text: ātharvaṇo 'yaṃ kathito vidhis te saṃkṣepato bhārgavāṃśamukhya /
children.translated_text: This procedure of the <s>Atharvaveda</s> (<s>ātharvaṇa vidhi</s>) has been told to you in brief, O foremost of the <s>Bhārgava</s> lineage,

children.text: ataḥ paraṃ kiṃ kathayāmi tubhyaṃ tan me vadasvāyatalohitākṣa // Vdho_2,127.52 //
children.translated_text: what else shall I tell you after this? Tell me that, O wide lotus-eyed one (<s>āyatalohitākṣa</s>). // <s>Vdho</s> 2,127.52 //

body.text: // iti śriviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne 'tharvavidhikathanaṃ nāma saptaviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ //
body.translated_text: // Thus, in the illustrious <s>Viṣṇudharmottara</s>, in the second section (<s>khaṇḍa</s>), in the dialogue of <s>Mārkaṇḍeya</s> and <s>Vajra</s>, in the narrative of <s>Puṣkara</s> addressed to <s>Rāma</s>, the chapter called 'The Description of <s>Atharva</s> Procedures' — the one hundred and twenty-seventh chapter. //
